subject: Codeforces Round 1122 (Div. 3)
body:
Hello mahikomohammed,

You are welcome to register and compete in Codeforces Round 1122 (Div. 3). It starts on Monday, September, 21, 2026 14:35 (UTC). The contest duration is 2 hours and 30 minutes. The allowed programming languages are C/C++, Python, Java, Kotlin, Rust, Go, C#, F#, Pascal/Delphi, JavaScript, D, Haskell, OCaml, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Scala.

Div. 3 rounds are designed especially for participants with a rating below 1600. You are invited to participate in the competition!

The goal of such rounds is to help beginner participants to gain skills and to get new knowledge in a real contest. You can read the details in this post. In short:

* Not only real problems, but also exercises can be used.
* Our main goal is to give you effective training problems, the novelty of the problems isn't the priority.
* Text of the statements is often formal.
* Rated for participant with the rating below 1600.
* ICPC rules + 12-hour open hacking phase.
* Untrusted participants are not included in the official ranklist.

The round will be held on the rules of Educational Rounds, so read the rules (here) beforehand. The round will be for newbies and participants with a rating below 1600. Want to compete? Do not forget to register for the contest and check your handle on the registrants page. The registration will be open for the whole duration of the contest.

If you have any questions, please feel free to ask me on the pages of Codeforces. If you no longer wish to receive these emails, click https://codeforces.com/unsubscribe/contests/9bc6c503d0829ec8fc9ded3fdf9eb8282a28c37d/ to unsubscribe.

Wish you high rating, Mike Mirzayanov and Codeforces team
